outcome: health consequences for mother and newborn
cohort: The reference population consisted of normal risk pregnant women, subdivided into primiparous and multiparous women with previous uterine scar.
finding: Natural childbirth was dominant for primiparous normal risk pregnant women due to lower cost and better or equal effectiveness, while C-section was more efficient for multiparous women with previous uterine scar.
mod_finding: Natural childbirth was more cost-effective for primiparous normal risk pregnant women, whereas elective C-section showed greater efficiency for multiparous women with previous uterine scar.
followup_time: from admission for delivery to maternity hospital discharge
